title: Australian Dollar hangs near three-week low, above 0.7100 as USD stands firm ahead of Fed
summary: The AUD/USD pair sticks to a negative bias for the second consecutive day and trades around the 0.7120 region during the early part of the European session on Tuesday.

title: Dow Jones futures fall as traders brace for Fed rate decision
summary: Dow Jones futures fall by 0.56% to trade near 52,150 during European hours on Tuesday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures decline by 0.42% to trade around 7,590, while Nasdaq 100 futures drop by 0.37% to trade near 29,050.

title: Indian Rupee: RBI seen starting mini hiking cycle - Societe Generale
summary: Societe Generale’s Kunal Kundu expects the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to respond to India’s broadening inflation pressures with a new mini rate-hike cycle. Kundu projects a 25bp hike in October, followed by two similar moves in December and February.

title: Federal Reserve: Rate hiking path and global yields – BNY
summary: BNY’s John Velis expects the Federal Reserve to raise rates by 25bp at this week’s FOMC meeting and sees another hike as likely later this year.

title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Finds bids below 61.8% Fibo retracement
summary: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) recovers half of its early losses against the US Dollar (USD), but is still 0.17% down at around 0.5770 during the European trading session on Tuesday.
